All activities at the Whitewater Center expose the participants to hazards of risk. Each participant must sign the Assumption of Risk, Waiver and Release Agreement prior to participating in any activity at the Whitewater Center. This agreement can be found on the Whitewater Center website should a guest choose to sign the waiver prior to their visit. A parent or legal guardian will be required to sign for any participant under the age of 18. Whitewater Center activities will operate in the rain. Activities will go on standby during the threat of lightning or in the event of severe weather. Activities will re-open as soon as the weather permits. Please check the weather conditions before visiting the Whitewater Center. Passes, reservations, camps, instruction courses, and event registrations are non-refundable and non-transferable. This pass has no cash value and cannot be combined with any other offer. This pass may not be sold, copied, or redistributed in any way.
